title: Governance coherence
objective: Roles; policies; and artifacts are consistent and non-contradictory across the ecosystem.
test_hint: Check RACI; policy index; cross-repo references

title: Anti-capture controls
objective: Governance changes require multi-stakeholder approval and are auditable.

title: Transparent adjudication
objective: Decisions and exceptions are logged with traceable rationale.
test_hint: Sample decisions; verify rationale and links

title: Change control & versioning
objective: Policy/schema changes follow a versioned lifecycle with review and rollback.

title: Access control
objective: Privileged access to governance and release assets is controlled.

title: Access review cadence
objective: Privileged access is reviewed on a defined cadence with remediation.

title: Separation of duties
objective: No single actor can unilaterally publish/activate high-impact changes.

title: Supply chain integrity
objective: Released artifacts are provenance-linked and integrity-checked.

title: Identity binding
objective: Actors and delegated agents are bound to identifiers with verifiable provenance.

title: Delegation constraints
objective: Delegated authority is scoped; time-bound; and revocable.

title: Lifecycle governance
objective: Actor/agent lifecycle events are recorded and enforce policy transitions.

title: Directory/registry correctness
objective: Registry entries are accurate; current; and change-controlled.

title: Evidence completeness
objective: Required evidence exists for the target profile + assurance level.

title: Traceability
objective: Control objectives are trace-linked to evidence and evaluation results.

title: Testability
objective: Claims are phrased in testable terms with clear evaluation criteria.

title: Repeatability
objective: Independent reviewers can reproduce the outcome from the artifacts.

title: Disclosure baseline
objective: Required disclosures are published (scope; assumptions; limitations).

title: Change disclosure
objective: Material changes are disclosed with rationale and version impacts.

title: Incident disclosure
objective: Relevant incidents and remediations are logged and disclosed per policy.

title: Continuity planning
objective: Continuity and recovery procedures exist for critical services.

title: Key management
objective: Key custody; rotation; and recovery are defined and evidenced.

title: Monitoring & response
objective: Monitoring and response mechanisms exist for critical controls.

title: Runtime admission control
objective: High-risk runtime actions are evaluated against policy and current status before execution produces an effect.
test_hint: Review runtime decision receipts and policy admission traces

title: Runtime decision traceability
objective: Runtime trust decisions are reproducible from structured receipts or tamper-evident traces that identify authority; policy; evidence; and resulting effect.
test_hint: Replay a sample decision from receipt fields and linked evidence

title: Fail-safe runtime behavior
objective: Systems deny; suspend; or degrade safely when policy state; delegation scope; or status freshness cannot be established at execution time.
test_hint: Test stale-status and missing-policy scenarios for fail-safe handling
